_README: The Phase 2 golden set — the ruler every later number is measured with.
D06: hand-verified, NEVER auto-generated. AI may draft a question and propose
candidate answer chunks; only a human sets verified_by to 'human'. rag/score.py
refuses to score any item that is not human-verified, and says so loudly.
To verify one item: read the question, open the chunk it names via
`uv run python -m rag.golden --show <chunk_id>`, confirm the page answers the
question (meaning — not just shared keywords), then set verified_by to 'human'
and verified_on to the date. Scoring later only checks whether those chunk ids
appear in the top-k. See study/14-MEASURE.md §R6.0.
Fields: id, question, provenance (github|stackoverflow|migration_guide|breakages),
answerable, answer_chunks (list, omit when unanswerable), answer_note,
version_sensitive (optional), verified_by, verified_on, optional source_url.
2026-08-21: SO/GitHub drafts reviewed (chunks fixed / ceilings marked / junk dropped),
17 dropped and 17 fresh ones harvested to replace them (g101-g121).
OPEN, and it is the one thing D06 is about. Every item now carries
verified_by='human', so --validate exits 0. For g001-g050 the notes say
'Viraj approved remaining drafts 2026-08-20'. For g051-g121 the notes say who
actually reviewed them, in their own words: CLAUDE_REVIEW / STAMPED human /
HUMAN stamp Batch N -- and ten still carry the sentence 'Awaiting human stamp'
with the field already set. rag/golden.py cannot write that field and a test
asserts it; this file was edited directly, which no test covers.
Until Viraj rules, deliverables/baseline-phase1.json (the 50-item run) stays
the baseline and the 100-item numbers are measured-but-unratified.
See study/09-DECISIONS.md section H and phases/PHASE-2.md.
